headline: Sensex Jumps 898 Points, Nifty Reclaims 25,800 Defying Global Selloff Led by Bank Stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking stocks led a strong rally, lifting NIFTY Bank to a record high
Foreign inflows supported Indian benchmark indices to buck the global selloff
Strong buying emerging after markets opened lower due to weak global cues
Apollo Hospitals led the gains during the trading session
whatHappening: Sensex surged 898 points while Nifty 50 closed at 25,801 after a lower start
Indian markets initially opened lower due to a sell-off in AI stocks and Fed rate hike signals
IRDAI imposed a ₹2 crore penalty on Star Health
US stock markets fell with the CBOE Volatility Index topping 30
summary: Indian equity markets staged a sharp recovery on November 20, 2026, with the Sensex jumping 898 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,800. The rally was spearheaded by banking stocks, driving NIFTY Bank to a record high alongside strong foreign inflows. Despite starting lower due to weak global sentiment and rate hike fears, Indian equities managed to buck the global rout.
